rules.statement: A constructive trust is not created if the deed of transfer does not indicate an intention to create a constructive trust or that any such information was furnished on the Notary.
rules.supporting_quote: In addition it was not evident from the said Deed, P1, that the money paid by the Respondent was a loan. The Appellant states that she had repaid the said sum with interest, however when asked why she didn't take steps to get a re-transfer of the property she was unable to provide a justifiable answer.
